info.title: ButtonBreakSwitch
info.author: StrongEnough
info.details: This is a port of the Button Break homebrew app for the Wii U.\n\nThis port is very similar to the homebrew app on the Wii U, but it is unfinished but still being worked on build by build.

changelog:
v0.6
This added support for the Nintendo Switch 2.
Also I made it way easier to exit the app with - and + and also added support for the separate B button on the NES/Famicom NSO controllers. Yes that exists. Apparently there was no way for the switch 1 and 2 to tell the B buttons apart in handheld mode, so they had to make that.
I know it has been a while, but I had to do a ton of stuff sadly but I will still keep trying to update this game... maybe.
